name: Instagram MCP - IG AutoDM
description: Manage Instagram via InstantDM (Meta Business Partner): publish posts/reels/stories/carousels, reply to comments publicly or by DM, send DMs, read your inbox, pull account/post insights, and monitor & answer comments on your Meta ads. Hosted server - connect with your InstantDM API key, nothing to install.
author: InstantDM

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Verify the InstantDM connection and get the linked Instagram account, plan, and remaining message credits. Call this first in a session. Free.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List the account's recent Instagram posts and reels with ids, captions, timestamps, permalinks, like and comment counts. Free.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Pass the previous result's paging.cursors.after to get the next page.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List comments on one Instagram post, with commenter username and comment id (use the id with reply_to_comment). Free.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Pass the previous result's paging.cursors.after to get the next page.

tools.name: reply_to_comment
tools.description: Reply to an Instagram comment, either publicly under the post or as a private DM to the commenter. Sends a real message and costs 1 credit — confirm the exact text with the user first.

visibility.description: public = visible reply under the post; private_dm = DM only the commenter sees

tools.name: send_dm
tools.description: Send an Instagram direct message to a user (use the sender id from a conversation or comment). Sends a real message and costs 1 credit — confirm the exact text with the user first. Instagram only allows messaging users who have interacted with the account.

recipient_id.description: Instagram-scoped user id of the recipient

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List recent Instagram DM conversations with participants, snippet of the last message, and unread count. Free.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Pass the previous result's paging.cursors.after to get the next page.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Get the messages of one DM conversation (newest first; Instagram returns full text only for the ~20 most recent). Free.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Pass the previous result's paging.cursors.after to get the next page.

tools.name: get_account_insights
tools.description: Account-level Instagram insights straight from the Graph API: window totals (reach, views, interactions, profile views), daily follower counts, audience demographics by country, and profile counters. Needs the account's insights permission. Free.

days.description: Window length in days, default 30 (Instagram's max per request)

tools.name: get_post_insights
tools.description: Insights for one post, reel, or story straight from the Graph API: reach, likes, comments, saves, shares, views (reels add watch time; stories add navigation). Free.

tools.name: list_ad_accounts
tools.description: List the Meta ad accounts linked to this profile. Requires the account to be connected via Facebook Login. Free.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Pass the previous result's paging.cursors.after to get the next page.

tools.name: list_ads
tools.description: List ads in an ad account, each with spend/impressions/clicks and the linked Instagram media id (creative.effective_instagram_media_id) used for comment tools. Filtered to ads for the connected Instagram account unless all_ads is true. Requires Facebook Login. Free.

ad_account_id.description: Ad account id from list_ad_accounts (act_ prefix optional)

all_ads.description: Include ads not linked to the connected Instagram account

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Pass the previous result's paging.cursors.after to get the next page.

tools.name: list_ad_comments
tools.description: List comments left on an ad's Instagram media (including boosted posts and dark posts). Requires Facebook Login. Free.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Pass the previous result's paging.cursors.after to get the next page.

tools.name: reply_to_ad_comment
tools.description: Reply to a comment on an ad, publicly or as a private DM to the commenter. Sends a real message and costs 1 credit — confirm the exact text with the user first.

visibility.description: public = visible reply; private_dm = DM only the commenter sees

tools.name: list_fb_page_posts
tools.description: List recent posts from the linked Facebook Page. Requires a connected Facebook Page. Free.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Pass the previous result's paging.cursors.after to get the next page.

tools.name: list_fb_page_comments
tools.description: List comments on a Facebook Page post. Requires a connected Facebook Page. Free.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Pass the previous result's paging.cursors.after to get the next page.

tools.name: reply_to_fb_comment
tools.description: Reply publicly to a Facebook Page comment. Sends a real reply and costs 1 credit — confirm the exact text with the user first.

tools.name: trigger_flow
tools.description: Start a pre-built InstantDM automation flow for a contact (e.g. a welcome or link-delivery sequence). May send multiple messages, each costing credits — confirm with the user first.

recipient_id.description: Instagram-scoped user id of the contact

tools.name: create_or_update_contact
tools.description: Tag or update an InstantDM CRM contact for an Instagram user (tags, notes, custom fields). Free.

contact_id.description: Instagram-scoped user id of the contact

contact_info.description: Fields to set on the contact

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Upload and publish a post, reel, story, or carousel to the connected Instagram account RIGHT NOW. Media must be publicly reachable URLs (images JPEG, videos MP4/MOV). Publishes to the real account and costs 1 credit — show the user the media URL(s) and caption and get confirmation first. If a video is still processing when the request ends, returns a container_id to finish with publish_post.

post_type.description: Defaults to image (or reel when the media is a video)

media.description: 1 item for image/reel/story; 2-10 for a carousel

caption.description: Post caption (hashtags allowed; not shown on stories)

tools.name: publish_post
tools.description: Publish a media container from an earlier create_post that was still processing (reels/videos). Costs 1 credit when it publishes. Returns status 'processing' if Instagram isn't done yet — wait and retry.

tools.name: disable_automation
tools.description: Pause ALL InstantDM automations for this account (account-wide, not per contact) so a human can take over. Reversible in the InstantDM app. Free — use only when the user explicitly asks.
